game.name: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship - Remastered

releases.displayName: 🛠️ Performance update, accessibility features and more!

items.text: Hello Riders! 🐎
We have been hard at work behind the scenes to improve the game's performance, add new accessibility features and address some common bugs submitted by the community.
Let's jump right in!
Adjustable haptic feedback strength
Created three camera distances, UI displayed in Free Ride
Added new control scheme to reflect new key binding
Added time dilation to obstacle jumping
Show jump indicator even at angles or when riding slowly
Accessibility Highlighting of Objects and Animals (+ sparkle)
Implemented settings to switch off motion blur
Color-Blind Mode Implementation
Camera Locking Improvements
Camera Tree Fade, iteration on camera collision
Show mouse cursor in popup and mission debrief widgets when not using a gamepad
Show mouse cursor while displaying mission popups
Overall better frame rate
Shortened Loading Screen Time
Loading Screen covers whole loading process
Introduction Video: Replaced waiting-for-video-delay with a timer based on the video duration
SteamDeck changes
Improve deer runaway animation and AI
Engine Upgrade
Play marker no longer invisible in snow
Search area markers now less intense
Localization updated
Correct keys now displayed in Controls
Fixed rotating horse statue material
Fixed collisions in Kaltenbach
Made the cave accessible on winter and summer map
Set up correct navigation for elements inside the pause menu
Refactor console settings menu
Use user-defined language to show splash screen text
Correctly save changed user settings
Set up correct navigation behavior for all elements within options
Fixed that player could no longer interact with the game behind the 'Mission Completed' popup after reset which caused the popup to remain stuck on screen
Fixed sleigh cameras not separated from 3rd person camera, creating better angle and no longer skipping input
Cleaned up freeride sleigh when resetting horse or returning to Kaltenbach
Starting either of the two blue marker 'Go for a Ride' missions no longer triggers the intro splash screen video
Increasing volume when using gamepad without losing focus
Spamming buttons to skip tutorials no longer freeze the game
Fixed potential crash during photo mission when no world can be derived from the mission object
Prevent moving backwards if the back of the horse is blocked
HUD elements are no longer duplicated if the mission is reset
Save settings in GameUserSettings instead of DefaultGame; correctly save benchmark result to prevent multiple benchmarks on the same install
Objects like wooden gates no longer have invisible walls
Fit controller scheme in settings (Steamdeck)
Resetting the horse in tutorial no longer causes screen misplacement
Can now navigate bottom menu in paddock with gamepad
Fix that changing the language in the options menu correctly applies the selected language
Cleaned up the camera intro for missions and prevented any camera input while the intro is still active
❤️ Please let us know what you think of the update. You can leave a comment here or come into our cozy Discord to discuss the game with us and other Riders.
See you in Kaltenbach!

items.text: Hello Riders! 🐎
🚧 We are currently rolling out a new patch to address some bugs and improved the performance of the Winter Wonderland DLC!

⚠️ If you do not see the update available for your region, you may have to wait until it is fully available for you or trigger the update manually by verifying the integrity of your installation files!
Potential fix for a severe save game bug caused by overlapping mission IDs of the base game and the DLC causing the game to skip missions in some cases.
⚠️Warning: this may cause some mission progress to be reset!⚠️
Fix for DLC Photo Missions 4 and 5 not being recognized as completed in the Photo Book
Adjusted height of the deep snow obstacles
Adjusted the Christmas Market unlocking to work with the save game fix
Performance improvement
Increased HLOD Instance Size
Decreased HLOD Load Raster
Switch back to traditional HLOD Settings from UE5 (HLOD Popping with old tool)
New Instancing Tool
Nanite Optimized Trees
Shadow Profiling
Material Optimization
Optimization in Nanite Buffer
Approximate Instances for Landscape Meshes
On low and Mid Settings: decreased Lumen Quality
Large Forest Imposters Lighting fix
Lighting fix on Landscape and certain Foliage (Grass and Bilberry Bushes)
Game Stats (VRAM 6.5 | RAM 5.5)

❤️ We are always seeking feedback to improve the performance of and any issues within the game. Please let us know what you would like us to improve. You can leave a comment here or come into our cozy Discord to discuss the game with us and other riders!
See you in Kaltenbach!

Hello winter riders! 🐎
We have fixed a few bugs and improved the performance of the Winter Wonderland DLC:
Deep Snow Obstacles added to Mission 2, 6, 14 and 22
Sleigh VFX adjustments for Deep Snow Obstacles
Fixed DLC loading images accidentally appearing within the base game
Collectables moved to ensure they can be reached in all Christmas market states
Achievement Unlocking Fixes (Winter Wonderland, Christmas Market)
Visual Reigns fix for Summer and Winter Mika on Horse
Multiple Performance improvements Improved adding depending on machine 5 – 10 FPS e.g:
HLODs and WP Streaming Distance
UDS Performance tweaks
Triplanar Projection Performance tweaks
Meshes Light resolution changes for non-nanite meshes
Animals fur materials cast shadow optimization
Horse Performance update with restructure

We are already galloping straight towards the next patch with more updates. Please let us know what you would like us to improve. You can leave a comment here or come into our cozy Discord to discuss the game with us and other riders.
See you in the next update!

Since the exciting release of Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship REMASTERED, we have received so much incredible feedback from the community about potential changes or issues within the game!

With the latest patch rolling out today, we wanted to give a full breakdown of all changes made to the game since launch! We separated changes into these major categories: Balancing and Quality of Life Changes, Technical Updates, and Bug Fixes!
Saddle up, because this is gonna be a long ride!

notes.title: Balancing and Quality of Life Changes
